title: Photophysical and DNA-Binding Properties of Phenoxazine-Based Push-Pull Type Organic Chromophores: Insights From DFT, Molecular Docking, and Optical Studies.
authors: Naik, Praveen; Aravinda, T; Gouthami, Kuruvalli; Reddy, Vaddi Damodara; Vinay Kumar, B; Yennawar, Neela H; Keremane, Kavya S
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吩噁嗪类有机染料与DNA的结合特性，采用DFT和分子对接方法，虽属蛋白质-DNA互作范畴但对象为小分子-DNA体系，方法可迁移至TF-DNA界面建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: In this work, we investigate the photophysical and DNA-binding characteristics of phenoxazine-based organic dyads comprising donor-acceptor configuration, with the goal of boosting their potential for biointeractive applications. The interaction of these dyes with calf thymus DNA was analyzed using UV spectroscopy, confirming their intercalative binding to DNA base pairs. A straightforward UV spectroscopic approach was developed to elucidate the binding mechanisms between DNA and the dyes. Furthermore, density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT calculations provided valuable insights into their electronic structures, optical parameters, and insights of frontier molecular orbitals. Molecular electrostatic potential simulations and mapping helped clarify the electron density distributions that are key for DNA interactions. Finally, molecular docking studies backed up these findings that the structural configuration of nucleic acids significantly influences the binding interactions of push-pull organic dyads, suggesting that these dyes could be promising for use in biological imaging and therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们研究了基于吩噁嗪的供体-受体构型有机二元体的光物理和DNA结合特性，旨在增强其在生物交互应用中的潜力。通过紫外光谱分析了这些染料与小牛胸腺DNA的相互作用，确认了它们与DNA碱基对的嵌入结合。开发了一种简便的紫外光谱方法，以阐明DNA与染料之间的结合机制。此外，密度泛函理论（DFT）和时间依赖密度泛函理论计算为其电子结构、光学参数及前沿分子轨道提供了有价值的见解。分子静电势模拟和映射有助于澄清对DNA相互作用关键的电子密度分布。最后，分子对接研究支持了这些发现，即核酸的结构构型显著影响推拉有机二元体的结合相互作用，表明这些染料在生物成像和治疗应用中具有前景。
